notes.title: Our game is now available on Nintendo!
Update 2.0
notes.notes:
[b]Update 2.0[/b]

-New quests.
-New scare system.
-Bug fixes.
-Optimization.
-Extras for collectibles and achievements.
-More bugs.
-New inventory system.
-Translation fixes.
-Small tweaks to improve the experience.

Note:
We'll bring some very good news in a couple of weeks!
